verdict.rationale: Graphite Chat and Agents let users interact via plain-language requests (e.g., 'Summarize the changes in this PR', 'Describe what you want built or fixed') to get code changes, PR summaries, and fixes without needing git/CLI syntax, and this is documented across multiple first-party pages. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that natural-language commands work reliably in practice, and confirmation this extends beyond PR chat/agents to broader product operations (e.g., CLI itself remains git-command based, not NL-driven).
